workflow_protocol.purpose: Use human repository navigation/manual exact edits and AI inspection/reasoning/verification together to reduce unnecessary context, output, compute, bandwidth, and human search effort without reducing correctness.
default_bounded_edit_pattern: inspect exact current repository file and branch
identify a confirmed Ctrl+F/search anchor and whole-function or bounded-block edit
provide complete existing and replacement blocks when practical
user may apply the exact edit manually
AI re-reads the result, checks for duplicates/remnants, runs syntax/static checks, and assesses unrelated-function impact
commit only under the user's chosen workflow
workflow_protocol.large_file_rule: Do not repeatedly reproduce or transfer a many-thousand-line file when a small verified range is sufficient; escalate to full-file generation only when broad interdependent edits make that safer.
workflow_protocol.quality_boundary: Efficiency never overrides correctness, security checks, explicit authorization, or deeper review for signing, wallet, backend, transaction, asset-identity, or liquidity-math changes.
